reviews.text: Thanks a bunch for the top rating, Hannah! We hope to see you and your furry friends again soon.
Thanks for the fantastic rating, Ernest! We look forward to welcoming you back soon.

Love the wide variety of items to choose from and, if you can’t make it to the store, the delivery service is amazing!  I had my items in a couple hours the first time I ordered! Prompt and courteous! Highly recommend Pets Supplies Plus!
Hi Jessica! Thanks a bunch for the 5-star shoutout! We're delighted you had a great experience. Come back anytime for more pet fun!
I placed an order online and it was ready in about an hour.
Good price on bag of science diet dry cat food
Hi Gladys! Thanks for the pawsome rating! We're so happy you enjoyed your visit. Hope to see you and your furry friends again soon!
I like the friendly, knowledgeable staff.  The products are good there, too.  Rajhae in the grooming department is great with our dogs.  I highly recommend this store for all your pets' needs.
Hi Dana! Your 5-star review made our day! We're so happy you enjoyed your time with us. See you and your pets again soon!
This store has the best prices in town, all the time I go into the store I am greeted and asked if I can be helped. Staff is very friendly and helpful.
Brought my dog here for a wash after our fun filled time at the dog park...towels and soap come in an abundance amount...great price and wonderful staff...

I am definitely not computer savvy- this is my second try. My Huge Border Collie Adelaide gets groomed by Coutney-she’s terrific. Border Collies have two coats of hair and sheds more than one can believe. She handles her in stride and always has a friendly smile. I will go to no one else. She’s gentle and kind, but gets the job done top to bottom! I also love that I’m able to have Addys favorite Dr. Marty’s food there which they deliver twice monthly. Oh, and the toys are great. Addy generally gets a new one after every visit with Courtney. They are priced reasonably. Go no where else. If you should have an issue, I am sure that this company will take care of you. They are customer friendly. I look forward to going there and highly recommend all of their services.
Stopped in to get treats for my Dane and Doodle. Lots of options which is awesome. I saw it has dog washing stations inside too so now I have to come back!
Very helpful staff

Courtney is absolutely amazing! She always does such a wonderful job grooming my dog and treats them with so much kindness and care. My dog comes home looking great, smelling fresh, and happy every time. It's clear that Courtney truly loves what she does and takes pride in her work. I appreciate her attention to detail and the extra care she gives to make sure every visit is a positive experience. I highly recommend Courtney to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring dog groomer!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Courtney Rediker did an absolutely amazing job grooming my cocker spaniel! She cut my dog’s hair perfectly and paid attention to every detail. Courtney clearly knows exactly what she’s doing. My dog came out looking clean, stylish, and better than ever. I’ve tried other grooming places before, but nobody has matched the quality, care, and expertise that Courtney provides. She is hands-down one of the best groomers I’ve ever worked with, especially for cocker spaniels. It’s obvious that she genuinely cares about the dogs she works with and takes pride in her craft. If you’re looking for a groomer who will make your dog look incredible, I highly recommend Courtney Rediker at Pet Supplies Plus. My dog has never looked better, and I’ll always keep coming back!
I bring my Mocha here for grooming services and she is always well taken care of by Angela Breaux & Courtney Rediker. Great prices too!
Quite literally have everything you need for your dog and good sales/deals!
Hi Ritchie! Thanks for the great rating. We're always here to make your pet's day a little brighter. Hope to see you and your furry friend again soon!

A big box pet store started in Michigan. But one thing that's different about here is that they have a Self-Serve Pet Wash and a dryer to dry your puppy. They have so much pet food here and a great selection of toys for the dogs. But do not get the fish here, the fish I got here dies so quickly. The customer service here is great as all the staff I talked to are nice and helpful.

I absolutely love this store for everything else, it’s truly a gem! However, I’ve had consistent challenges with the grooming services for poodle breeds. I’ve tried three different stylists, hoping for a better outcome, but unfortunately, the results have been the same each time.

I’m sharing this feedback because I know how amazing this store is in other areas, and I’d love to see the grooming services align with that high standard.

EDIT: I started taking my poodle to Courtney, and it's been nothing but positive. Revised my review :)

I've always had great experience at any Pet Supplies Plus store, and this location is no exception. The store is always clean. Even though there are a lot of animals in the store, it never smells bad. The animals up for purchase or adoption seem to be taken well care of and healthy. Staff are kind and helpful while not being overbearing. While I can only attest to the items I'm usually there to purchase (I have a chinchilla, hamster and cockatiel), I never have to worry about those items not being available. I really appreciate the clearance and sale shelves/baskets, and you can often find some great deals. All in all, I love shopping here. Thank you so much to this PSP location.

I understand having a bad day because we are all human but it makes me feel like a bother.

We just had a bad experience in store at the Kirkwood location. We wanted to buy (2) K9 Advantage Flea Prevention plus. Our coupon was advertised as around $80 with 40% off. However, when we got to the store, they were selling it for $99 each. After going back and forth for about 45 mins, and multiple attempts to give us a “discount” , which is still more than what it should be; the management still did want to honor the advertised coupon saying they can’t get any lower than the 40% off the $99. This is false advertisement. This place needs to get an accurate inventory of what they have, what specials they’ve sent out, and honor what they’ve advertised.

Update from my last review.

They helped me and exchanged my dogs food when they didn’t have to. I do appreciate that because again they could’ve stood on no.

This is just MY experience with the exchange. It could be different with others but I’m going to share anyway.

I completely understand companies policies and moving forward I know there are no returns on open goods. Totally fine.
The experience however, has left me feeling like why did I speak up for myself.
Heather was very condescending and passive with her remarks. Even when I got there, you could feel the tension and it was so uncomfortable.
Even the first girl I first spoke with on the phone, when I first reported my issue, had an unpleasant tone of delivery when letting me know they couldn’t return it.
Very snobby attitudes. Not the fact it’s policy, just the way people deliver the message.
I’m glad I spoke up though and I know they’ll be even happier knowing I won’t return to this location.

I came here to buy some food for my two kittens and I saw these babies up for adoption . it was so heartbreaking to see  how they didn’t have  no food or water (it was 95 degrees outside ).
It seems that they have  been like this for a while .  I know the kittens are there for adoption and that you are finding them homes, and I appreciate that (I wish I had a bigger apartment to take all of them ) but they need to be treated and cared better. You are a pet store and have animals in your care. You should know better.
